{{Quote|'Mount Lyss Meteorological Station, a long-abandoned government facility used during the Yuuzhan Vong War as a hideout by freedom fighters.' Tours apparently not available, as the place was abandoned again after the war and is in an ongoing state of decay.|Turman Durra|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Mount Lyss Meterological Station''' was a weather station on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]]. Despite its name, it was situated atop a hill  a couple of hundred meters high that rose from comparatively level ground surrounded by [[Grain/Legends|grain]] fields. It was abandoned by [[44 ABY]] following the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] occupation of the planet during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="MK" />
